findings: `components[1].sound` has incorrect historical readings: the dossier supplies Baxter–Sagart Middle Chinese 帀 `tsop` and 師 `srij`, and Old Chinese 帀 `*[ts]ˤ[ə]p` and 師 `*srij`. The entry labels the first pair `tsop` / `srij` as Middle Chinese, but labels that same pair as Old Chinese too. Replace the Old Chinese comparison with the supplied Old Chinese pair, keeping both readings in the same system and retaining the caveat that neither comparison establishes 帀’s phonetic role. Evidence: `X-8138e4aa22a14c7617d8`, `X-8583b12b9dd6d11e0ee4`.
